description: GPT pricing for every OpenAI model: USD per million input and output tokens, context length, max output and modalities for GPT, o-series and open-weight models, cheapest first, plus the cost of your call when you give token counts. Filter by name (q=gpt-5), price cap, context or image input. Source: OpenRouter's public model list. Use to pick an OpenAI model for a job or to estimate what a prompt will cost before sending it. Example: q=gpt. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

inputTokens.description: Input tokens of your call, to estimate its cost

maxInputPrice.description: Only models at or under this USD per million input tokens

minContext.description: Only models with at least this context length in tokens

outputTokens.description: Output tokens of your call, to estimate its cost

provider.description: Provider to list (default openai); any other provider name works too, e.g. google, meta-llama, mistralai

q.description: Words in the model id or name, e.g. gpt, claude, llama 70b

sort.description: input (default), output, blended (3:1 input:output) or context

vision.description: true: only models that take image input

name: gpt_pricing
title: GPT pricing: OpenAI API prices
